channel: candidate (dry run; not published to npm)
producedBy: npm ci && npm run build && npm run release:dry-run -- --channel candidate
consumer: apps/docs (file: dependencies; root overrides pin the transitive @bloxwap/hig-* versions to these files)
upgrade: Replace all three tarballs together from one HIG commit, update the hashes below and bun.lock, then run bun run docs:build and the Playwright suite.
rollback: Revert the owning PR to restore the previous lockfile and imports.
